summary.text: Ginny Lyons is the Democratic incumbent state senator for the Chittenden Southeast District and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
She is a longtime college professor and chairs the Senate Health and Welfare Committee.

paragraphs.text: Lyons earned an A.B. from Drew University in 1966, an M.S. from Rutgers University in 1968 and an Ed.D. from the University of Vermont in 1988.

Her career includes work as an instructor at Middlesex County College from 1968 to 1971 and as a professor at Trinity College from 1973 to 2000, where she was also coordinator and director of Allied Health from 1978 to 2000.
She became a professor at Vermont State College in 2000 and served on the Williston Select Board from 1990 to 2000.

Lyons's assignments for the 2025-2026 legislative session include the Senate Appropriations Committee, the Economic Development, Housing and General Affairs Committee and the Senate Rules Committee, along with chair of the Health and Welfare Committee.
